scope: Actual shipping macOS package in exclusive QA Library; compact widths, native zoom, keyboard, and live multi-page journal reading. No real-model, feed, endurance, GPU or collaborator acceptance.
boundedFallback: If native height resizing remains unavailable, record actual geometry and zoom separately; do not claim intended dimensions.
checks: Create remains Ready until explicit Start
At least21 entries before multi-page traversal
Pin older entry; Older/Newer history and Refresh preserve selected text during arrivals
Earlier/Later across20-row boundary; explicit Follow latest
Workspace return, reachable actions, closed evidence, keyboard evidence scrolling
View zoom and Actual Size; source and retained prose unchanged
Natural step361 hold, then normal quit
Same-build read-only sustained verification and all-file hash equality
stopRule: No retries, silent budget extensions or provider switching; retain partial outcome if any bound prevents complete native coverage.
cleanup: Quit only the owned QA app; preserve package, source and session evidence.
